biggest_catch: The offer ends September 30, 2026 - referrals must be completed by then.
catches: Referring member and referred individual each receive a $50 reward when the new member qualifies.
New member must open an eligible personal account with a minimum opening deposit of $250 and maintain the account in good standing for 60 days.
Referral code is required and must be entered in Digital Banking at the time the new membership account is opened.
Rewards are paid after all eligibility requirements are met and verified.
Limit 10 referral rewards per referring member ($500).
Rewards may be subject to applicable taxes; reported to the IRS as required by law.
Offer may be changed or withdrawn at any time; membership eligibility guidelines apply.

Share it with a friend or family member.
Friend opens an eligible personal account with a $250 minimum opening deposit and enters your referral code.
